issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies Farm.animals as a private attribute with getter/setter, but the solution implementation declares the animals field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This visibility mismatch contradicts the encapsulation implied by the exercise instructions and the UML, and may confuse students about the intended access level and use of the getter/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) and keep the public getter and setter. This aligns the implementation with the UML and the exercise instructions about encapsulation.
